method: Precinct returns disaggregated to ZCTAs (Fekrazad 2025, RLCR); two-party margins in percentage points, positive = more Democratic. ZCTA-years with fewer than 50 fractional votes are masked. Group rates are population-weighted; associations are ecological (about places, not voters).
source: Fekrazad (2025) precinct-level returns disaggregated to ZCTAs via RLCR dasymetric weighting (fractional votes); two-party margins. Conterminous US only (no AK/HI).
